name: Family Hub
description: The household organiser the whole family talks to: shared shopping and packing lists, a fair chore rotation with swaps and weekly scores, and family events with reminders.

settings.label: Family members
settings.help: First names, one per line. Chores rotate between them in this order. If empty, everyone who messages the hub joins the rotation.

settings.label: Chores
settings.help: One per line: the chore, then daily or weekly (and a day for weekly ones), e.g. "Dishes daily", "Trash weekly mon", "Vacuum weekly".
settings.placeholder:
Dishes daily
Trash weekly mon
Laundry weekly sat
Bathroom weekly sun
